summary: I’m a Technical Lead and Generative AI Engineer focused on building intelligent, high-scale systems that merge traditional full-stack engineering with next-generation AI capabilities.  Over the past decade, I’ve led architecture modernization initiatives across e-commerce, analytics, and workflow automation driving multimillion-pound cost reductions, boosting performance, and introducing AI-augmented features like semantic search and agentic workflows.  I’m particularly interested in AI-enhanced infrastructure, multi-cloud orchestration (AWS, Azure, GCP), and scalable developer ecosystems. My engineering philosophy is rooted in system design, observability, and enabling teams to ship fast with confidence.
